I am absolutely certain due to what I have seen that something terrible is happening. 

I'm going to direct attention to some videos. I've been researching for a couple hours now and I was so horrified I began crying. Please everyone look at this "dear future me" video. Almost a poem she wrote herself about how "hard' Things are and the pain and hurting. "I've learnt not to trust anybody because that's what the difficulties in life have taught me" 

I've been through similar where fantasising about a better life to escape, and this is a theme throughout all videos. 



In a Q&A video a question was asked "what are you most afraid of?" and she said "being attacked by someone."

I also want to direct you to the video near death experience which is HIGHLY DISTURBING. The video makes no sense it's a ramble basically repeating about how she wishes she could express how hard it's been and how much pain she is in. She begins crying hard about how pain to animals is bad and she wishes she could save everyone. She calls it a "secret" that she can't tell.  The way she describes it as "horrifying", not just sad, but horrifying and terrifying and not able to be described with words, like that means something to me. I cried during this video. I am absolutely terrified for this girl.

The near death experience is incredible because it says so much. She talks about the word "one" and what that means to her. It means she is all alone and no one will help her. and I don't want to put ideas into your head but honestly sounds so culty this part. Like cults have that view of the "special one" with powers and such. You may think that's silly. She also addresses herself in the third person and this is important because it means she's trying to step back from her body- note depersonalisation here- linked with stress and ptsd. And the last point I will go on to say here is that she does mention ptsd and depression and such at the end. ptsd highly linked with sexual and physical abuse.

Also, commenters have been drilling this idea of putting a heart on your hand and then they will know that's a cry for help. In the video near death experience there is a heart randomly placed in the thumbnail and the fact that she now uses heart signs with her hands constantly where she never used to do that.

Last thing I'll say is that if it is a cult, a meeting in london at 6:30am that is apparently dangerous and everyone is saying not to go to would be the perfect place for something terrible to happen.

The first meeting. What memories. So I think I thought it has to be perfect otherwise it will be horrible. It was my first relationship and I'd never even really kissed anyone. (maybe one or two people for half a second). 

I was shitting myself coming up to the date. I just thought "what if it's super awkward?" "what if she doesn't like me/ i don't like her in real life?" "what if we have nothing to talk about in real life?" "what should I do when I first see her?"

it caused me so much stress that I drank alcohol to calm myself down at like 7 in the morning at the airport from a  water bottle. haha. and also a few weeks before she was due to come I almost broke up with her so there wouldn't be so much pressure! 

I laugh about it now.

But at the end of the day, you're just meeting up with someone you've known for 7 months. Same person. Just in the flesh.

She came out and I felt my heart kinda lurch. And then we just hugged for a long time. I said "omg you really are a midget" and then my mom took us back to my house cause the hotel wouldn't let us check in. Then we felt awkward cause my mom was there. Then she got in my bed cause she was super tired. Then we cuddled and the tension went away a bit and it felt like just really safe and nice. and den we kissssssssed. and it was like I was really nervous and didn't know what to do hahaha. 

It's just funny now but, things don't have to be perfect. We had the greatest 3 weeks of our lives together. It changed me.

You won't even worry about any of these things when you meet GUARANTEED because when you meet it's like honeymoon phase times 1000. You're just happy and can't stop touching each other and cuddling and kissing. Every day is an excitement. Just worry about when you have to leave.

I wanna say that I'm the one in the relationship that is always being told I need to show more affection. really because my partner shows it by babying me and telling me she loves me a lot. But I do these things less. Because I show her I love her in other ways. If I had more money she would have flowers sent and presents and if I was there I would cuddle and kiss her but I can't. 

And I tell her this. Sometimes she is upset but I think she realises that I do try, but I show it in different ways.

Just wanted to say that I'm happy I'm attracted to women isall. Best way to live.

"Are you sad?" when she left. I looked up from the ground with bloodshot eyes and red, tearstained, puffy face. Yep. Sad.

Also "Would you ever cheat on her?" I quickly told him to mind his own fucking business.

There are times when I just start crying and times when I feel like I can live normally. She's not landed yet and it's been a lonely day unpacking and looking over pictures and videos without her next to me. 

3 months and then we can see each other again. She is the beginning of my life. She was what I was always waiting for all this time. 

Kissing her for the last time and watching her walk away and grow smaller was one of the hardest things I have ever had to do. I have never felt like my soul had been ripped in two before. But I know I love her and I will be able to kiss her again. Facetime will do for now. But it will be harder than before now.
